dependencies.note: Exact version1.1.2 missing package LICENSE; official npm gitHead fcef0668a5c827e5a4baac405474d75680f9a4eb full MIT reused from reviewed evidence.

modifications: Original full three-part demo and layout/marketing copy retained. Only image URL references/import aliases changed in Cult sources.
Two original text SVGs safely percent-encoded locally, not binary encoding; no remote image fetch. XML whitelist svg/path/polygon, no href/style/script/image/foreignObject.
Paper0.0.72 original heatmap blur and liquid-metal Poisson preprocessing and full GLSL retained; transient native Canvas PNG blobs generated locally, never uploaded or packaged.

Lifecycle additions: local-image URL guard, listener/image/objectURL release, async alive/error guards and missing-src cancellation after liquid preprocessing await; original heatmap/liquid generated blob URL revoked on cleanup.
Original internal one-pixel binary GIF replaced by equivalent transparent1px SVG during processing only, not a replacement core effect.
WebGL2 preflight/compile/link/context loss/draw failure stop explicitly with no substitute visual; hidden unmount/remount, reduced motion forces speed0 but renders static shader.
Original CTA links retained as source/navigation labels, clicks prevented with local explanatory status; no actual AI service/remote navigation.
System fonts and existing approved light theme CSS tokens; no webfonts.
scope: Source hashes and complete source evidence, not an assertion of full upstream git tree verification. Public runtime/docs/notices only; full build workspace remains local, no downloadable source ZIP promised.
